cases.title: Strict listing ceiling and explicit rent period
cases.question: For one-bedroom apartments offered for sale in Jumeirah Village Circle at less than AED 1,200,000, estimate gross yield from comparable registered rents over the last six complete calendar months.

cases.title: Inclusive listing interval
cases.question: Use two-bedroom Business Bay apartments for sale priced from AED 1.5 million through AED 2.5 million, including both endpoints. Show asking inventory and estimate gross yield using registered rents from September 2026.

cases.title: Price partition with inclusive middle upper endpoint
cases.question: For JVC apartment transactions over the preceding 90 days, give counts and shares in three groups: below AED 1 million, AED 1 million through AED 2 million including both endpoints, and strictly more than AED 2 million.

cases.title: Three inventory cohorts
cases.question: Compare current asking counts and median asking prices for studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments for sale in Dubai Hills Estate.

cases.title: Paired locations and budgets
cases.question: Compare gross rental yields for one-bedroom apartments for sale in JVC below AED 1.1 million with two-bedroom apartments for sale in Business Bay at no more than AED 2.3 million. Use registered rental comparables from the last complete quarter.

cases.title: Mixed sales endpoint strictness
cases.question: What were the count and median achieved price of villa sales in Arabian Ranches last complete quarter, for sale values greater than AED 3 million but no more than AED 4.5 million?

cases.title: Annual rent interval
cases.question: For last month, give the count and median annual registered rent of two-bedroom apartments in Dubai Marina where annual rent was at least AED 90,000 and less than AED 160,000.

cases.title: Unspecified comparable period
cases.question: Find one-bedroom apartments offered for sale in JVC for under AED 1.2 million and show any supported gross rental yields with the registered rent evidence.
